title: OSM OpenMapTiles
description: The official style of OpenMapTiles, designed to display all features in vector tiles. Heavily inspired by OSM Carto.

title: MapTiler Basic
description: MapTiler Basic is a basemap that tries to stay in the background and only give the most relevant information.

title: OSM Bright
description: OSM Bright is a general-purpose basemap showcasing the great detail of OpenStreetMap data. It is a good starting point for your own complex basemaps.

title: Positron
description: Positron is a beautiful light basemap, ideal as a non-obtrusive base for your data visualizations. The cartography by Stamen Design is licensed under CC-BY.

title: Dark Matter
description: Dark Matter is a dark basemap and a good starting point for other darker designs. The cartography by Stamen Design is licensed under CC-BY.

title: Fiord Color
description: Fiord Color is a cool blue-toned basemap optimized for data visualizations. Its muted color palette keeps your data layers in focus while providing clear geographic context.
